# Janet

## Overview

- **Age:** forty  <sub>[v3 ch.Last P51](../source/v03-c34.md#nw-v03-c34-p0051)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_

## Appearance

Janet is a nice-looking, stoutish woman who is tall without being over-tall. She features a sunny face with rosy cheeks, big kind eyes as blue as forget-me-nots, and a knot of soft, crimpy brown hair that contains a thread of gray.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Philippa P1](../source/v03-c31.md#nw-v03-c31-p0001)_

## History

Miss Janet Sweet was a resident of [Valley Road](../codex/places.md#valley-road) who lived at [Wayside](../codex/places.md#wayside), where she took in [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) as a boarder during Anne's time as a local schoolteacher. For twenty years, Janet was courted by her neighbor [John Douglas](../character/john-douglas.md), though he never proposed; on her fortieth birthday, she broke down in tears over the situation and briefly snubbed John following Anne's advice to stand up for herself. After John's overbearing mother passed away, John revealed that a secret oath to his late mother had prevented him from marrying, and he finally proposed to Janet.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Romance P1](../source/v03-c30.md#nw-v03-c30-p0001), [v3 ch.Romance P2](../source/v03-c30.md#nw-v03-c30-p0002), [v3 ch.Romance P5](../source/v03-c30.md#nw-v03-c30-p0005), [v3 ch.Romance P6](../source/v03-c30.md#nw-v03-c30-p0006), [v3 ch.Romance P7](../source/v03-c30.md#nw-v03-c30-p0007), [v3 ch.Romance P8](../source/v03-c30.md#nw-v03-c30-p0008), +83 more_

## Quotes

> "Oh, she does. She’s told me time and again that she’d love to see John settled before her time comes. She’s always giving him hints—you heard her yourself the other day. I thought I’d ha’ gone through the floor."
>
> — Janet — [v3 ch.Coming” P10](../source/v03-c33.md#nw-v03-c33-p0010)

> "You see, Anne, I’ve always been awful fond of John. He might just as well keep coming as not, for there was never anybody else I’d want, so it didn’t matter."
>
> — Janet — [v3 ch.Coming” P13](../source/v03-c33.md#nw-v03-c33-p0013)

> "No, I guess not. I was afraid to try, anyway, for fear he’d think I meant it and just go. I suppose I’m a poor-spirited creature, but that is how I feel. And I can’t help it."
>
> — Janet — [v3 ch.Coming” P16](../source/v03-c33.md#nw-v03-c33-p0016)

> "I know the road home pretty well alone. I ought to, seeing I’ve been traveling it for forty years. So you needn’t trouble yourself, Mr. Douglas."
>
> — Janet — [v3 ch.Coming” P23](../source/v03-c33.md#nw-v03-c33-p0023)

> "Oh, I’m just as glad you did. When I saw John Douglas making off down that road I just felt as if every little bit of joy and happiness that was left in my life was going with him. It was an awful feeling."
>
> — Janet — [v3 ch.Coming” P31](../source/v03-c33.md#nw-v03-c33-p0031)

## Relationships

### [Anne](../character/anne.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne--janet.md)

Janet and [Anne](../character/anne.md) are friendly confiding acquaintances and neighbors who meet while [Anne](../character/anne.md) is staying in [Valley Road](../codex/places.md#valley-road). Janet introduces [Anne](../character/anne.md) to local gatherings, such as a prayer meeting, and confides in her about her deeply troubled personal life, including her forty-year birthday distress over her stagnant courtship with [John Douglas](../character/john-douglas.md). [Anne](../character/anne.md) offers Janet advice to stand up for herself and later helps resolve the misunderstandings surrounding John's delay, while the two also share lighthearted moments like laughing together over unwanted suitors.

- Friend of — friendly confiding acquaintance and neighbour at Redmond  <sub>[v3 ch.Last P45](../source/v03-c34.md#nw-v03-c34-p0045)</sub>
